world.name: Hairline

decision.declined: Direction roll skipped: a user-pinned reference beats the roll. Replaces Spec Sheet; pills, mint and the guarded blur reversed its bans at the owner's word.

dosageRules: Mint marks active, live, outcome, the console command, the current role and the hero key phrase. Never decoration, never chrome.
Coral for problems, sky for flows and stack trails, gold for awards. No era or category colours.
Light tokens are written twice in the kit (OS-preference block and [data-theme="light"]); change both.
Geist Mono for commands, data, dates, stack, slugs, labels, and the single primary CTA in uppercase; secondary buttons are Geist sentence case.
Soft radial glows and a static hero mesh; nothing in the mesh animates.
bannedPatterns: Eyebrows or kickers above headings; .hl-label is for data labels only
Mint on decoration, chrome or links at rest; gold outside awards; era colours
Animated layers inside the hero mesh
Mono-caps on secondary or ghost buttons
color-mix() and the individual translate/rotate/scale properties (old Edge WebView)
backdrop-filter outside @supports or without an opaque fallback
Typed figures in markup; every figure is derived from cv.json
Visual design on the printed CV
world.overview: The portfolio as a running engineering console. A near-black #050709 ground (light #f6f7f9), a 1px #2e3238 blueprint grid framing every section, two-tone Geist headings, and Geist Mono for commands and data. A mint #6ee7a0 accent (emerald #047857 in light) is spent only on state. Pill CTAs and chips, 12px cards, 16px console windows. The hero console runs the real case studies on a 6s autoplay. Pinned by the owner on 2026-10-09 to jsmastery.com's agentic-engineering course page, replacing the Spec Sheet world.

line.purpose: The 1px grid that frames every section; card and window edges.

text-1.purpose: Headings and the key words of two-tone headings.

accent.purpose: State only: active, live, outcome, the console command, the current role, the hero key phrase.

display.purpose: Hero headline, two-tone, mint key phrase; hero sizes to clamp(2.5rem, 1.1rem + 3.2vw, 3.75rem).

headline.purpose: Section titles: dim lead-in, text-1 key words; never mint.

meta.purpose: Console lines, commands, data, dates, stack, slugs.

label.purpose: Data labels only (console status, dt terms, counters); never an eyebrow above a heading.

cta.purpose: The single primary pill; ghost and secondary buttons are Geist 600 sentence case.

motion.name: hero-enter
motion.purpose: Headline lines settle once on load.

motion.name: console-run
motion.value: lines fade 300ms; result pops 500ms with overshoot; 6s autoplay
motion.purpose: The signature run; pauses on hover, focus, offscreen, hidden tab.

motion.name: rail-grow
motion.purpose: The current role's segment grows on reveal.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: all completed states shown; no autoplay, marquee wraps static, no pulse/sheen/float

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.purpose: Header single row; tab strip stops scrolling; console log 18rem.

breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.purpose: Hero 58/42, compare and tab panels go two-column.

material.grid: .hl-grid owns side rules, .hl-cell owns top and start rules, -1px start margin so seams never double
material.glows: radial --hl-glow-accent / --hl-glow-gold orbs behind hero, skills panel and awards; static --hl-hero-mesh behind the hero
material.blur: header and dock only, 12px, inside @supports over an opaque --hl-header-bg fallback

components.name: Primary Pill
components.description: The one mono-uppercase CTA voice: white fill (ink in light), 56px pill, 7s sheen under motion, lifts 2px with a glow on hover.

components.name: Ghost Pill
components.description: Secondary action: Geist 600 sentence case on a translucent fill with a soft line.

components.name: Slug Chip
components.description: Mono pill; active state is mint text, mint wash, mint edge and chip glow. Long labels ellipsize in .hl-chip__label.

components.name: Card
components.description: 12px, surface-2, hairline edge; hover lights the edge mint with a top wash. Featured variant: travelling lit ring.

components.name: Console Window
components.description: 16px window: traffic dots, mono title, bottom-anchored log ($ command in mint, stack trail in sky, ◆ result chip), live status row, slug chips.

components.name: Tabs with Ring
components.description: Hairline tab strip, keycap hover, mint underline on the selected tab, 7s progress ring; scroll row with trailing fade under 720px.

components.name: Compare
components.description: Problem (coral wash) beside outcome (mint wash), joined by one coral-to-mint lit rule.

components.name: Career Rail
components.description: Neutral 1px rail; only the current role carries the 3px mint bar (grows by scaleY) and the live dot.

components.name: Ruled Grid
components.description: The blueprint frame for every section: 1px rules, shared seams.

narrative.overview: The portfolio as a running engineering console. A mint #6ee7a0 accent (emerald #047857 in light) is spent only on state. Pill CTAs and chips, 12px cards, 16px console windows. The hero console runs the real case studies on a 6s autoplay. Pinned by the owner on 2026-10-09 to jsmastery.com's agentic-engineering course page, replacing the Spec Sheet world.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-first near-black ground with surfaces stepping up 2-4%; a light theme on the same structure.
A 1px ruled blueprint grid frames every section.
Mint spent only on state; coral problems, sky flows, gold awards.
Two-tone Geist headings; Geist Mono for data and the single primary CTA.
Pills for CTAs and chips, 12px cards, 16px console windows.
The hero console runs the real case studies; skills autoplay on a 7s ring; the career rail lights only the current role.

rules.name: The State-Only Mint Rule
rules.body: Mint marks active, live, outcome, the console command, the current role and the hero key phrase. Never decoration, never chrome.

rules.name: The Semantic Hue Rule
rules.body: Coral for problems, sky for flows and stack trails, gold for awards. No era or category colours.

rules.name: The Twice-Written Rule
rules.body: Light tokens are written twice in the kit (OS-preference block and [data-theme="light"]); change both.

rules.name: The Blueprint Rule
rules.body: A 1px --hl-line ruled grid frames every section; seams never double.

rules.name: The Two-Tone Rule
rules.body: Dim lead-in words, text-1 key words; mint key phrase in the hero only; no gradient text.

rules.name: The One Mono Voice Rule
rules.body: Geist Mono for commands, data, dates, stack, slugs, labels, and the single primary CTA in uppercase; secondary buttons are Geist sentence case.

rules.name: The Still Ground Rule
rules.body: Soft radial glows and a static hero mesh; nothing in the mesh animates.

rules.name: The Running Console Rule
rules.body: The console runs real case studies from cv.json, autoplays every 6s and pauses on hover, focus, offscreen or a hidden tab.

rules.name: The Additive Motion Rule
rules.body: Content hides only under html.hl-motion or .js-motion; reduced motion shows every completed state.

rules.name: The Old WebView Rule
rules.body: No color-mix(), no individual translate/rotate/scale; backdrop-filter only inside @supports over an opaque fallback.

rules.name: The Mirror Rule
rules.body: Header, dock, hero console and figures, marquee, skills tabs, testimonial card and /styleguide are mirrored in _tools/prerender.py; change both sides.

rules.name: The Plain CV Rule
rules.body: /cv stays ATS-plain white paper; only its action row wears the world.

dos: Derive every console line and figure from cv.json.
Give interactive chrome a static counterpart in prerender.py.
Verify both themes at 390x844 and at desktop width.
donts: Eyebrows or kickers above headings; .hl-label is for data labels only
Mint on decoration, chrome or links at rest; gold outside awards; era colours
Animated layers inside the hero mesh
Mono-caps on secondary or ghost buttons
